originalFamilyScopeSummary: Display all fills for multi-fill close orders in perps activity tab instead of only showing last batch
currentTriggerSummary: pr-complete: fix(perps): perps activity tab only shows last batch of fills for multi-fill close orders
notes: The merged transform groups by asset + direction category + order id, so a close order that filled across several price levels or several seconds collapses into one row carrying summed size, PnL and fee - the family's stated defect. It goes further than the close-only scope on purpose: opens and flips, which the pre-fix code excluded from grouping entirely, now aggregate too, and close-category fills keep a same-second seed with a transitive union across order ids so a triggered TP/SL split into several child orders (TAT-2196) still lands as one entry. All three surfaces named in TAT-3931 (Activity page Perps > Trades, Perps home, Perps asset detail) render from the single transformFillsToTransactions call that was changed. Evidence: inherited recipe coverage records 4/4 ACs PROVEN (inputs/inherited/recipe-coverage.md), and the recipe re-run on the rebased branch passed 27/27 nodes, with on-device assertions for the full 8.29 SOL size and the -$1.15 total fee on all three surfaces (artifacts/recipe-run/). Unit coverage pins the multi-second close (6 fills over 74s) and the multi-fill flip (startPosition preserved) cases: 126/126 pass. One known gap, explicitly out of scope for this mobile ticket and called out in the PR body: the extension carries an identical copy of the transform at ui/components/app/perps/utils/transactionTransforms.ts with the same defect and needs its own PR.
